name: Alt Flow
description: Spam fast enough and it takes over, clicking at a steady rate you choose. Comes with a clean control panel.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Also the switch at the top of the panel, or the Toggle key.

toggle-key.name: Toggle key
toggle-key.description: Turns the assist on or off from anywhere.

panel-key.name: Panel key
panel-key.description: Opens or closes the control panel (on phones: the alt flow button in the pause menu).

replay-tutorial.name: Replay tutorial
replay-tutorial.description: Turn on to see the short tour again the next time you open the panel.

show-cps.name: Show CPS
show-cps.description: Your clicks per second in the bottom-left corner; turns green while the assist is spamming for you.

trigger-cps.name: Trigger CPS
trigger-cps.description: Spam at least this fast and the assist takes over. Stop spamming and you get control back.

quick-start.name: Quick start
quick-start.description: Kick in after 2 fast clicks instead of 3, so it reacts sooner when a spam part starts. Can trigger on fast double jumps.

go-straight.name: Go straight
go-straight.description: Ship, wave, ufo and swing: hold the height you started spamming at, so you fly flat. The CPS below is the fastest it clicks. Turn off to spam at a fixed rhythm that can drift up or down.

rhythm.name: Speed
rhythm.description: fixed: spam at the speeds below. match your speed: spam at the rate you're clicking, just perfectly even.

hold-percent.name: Hold %
hold-percent.description: How much of each click is held down, when not going straight. Higher makes the ship climb more and the wave go up longer.

wave-path.name: Wave path
wave-path.description: straight: the wave follows Go straight and stays level. up or down: ascending or descending wave spam, at the Wave CPS, tilted by Wave angle.

wave-angle.name: Wave angle
wave-angle.description: How steeply up and down tilt the wave spam, in degrees. 20 is a steady climb, 35 is steep.
